verdicts.reason: Both use the same two-column 300x250 layout. The console-symbol hero is shrunk to a small strip, and the pink question wraps into a narrow, ragged six-line column. The 3-day-event fine print is tiny and barely legible, and a large dead band sits under the URL. A's right column runs 'MAY,14TH' almost to the canvas edge with no right margin. B wraps that copy earlier, so it keeps a margin and has slightly more even leading, which makes it marginally cleaner.
